Official GraphML 1.0 XML Schema, vendored so the export conformance checks
validate offline and deterministically.

Fetched from http://graphml.graphdrawing.org/xmlns/1.0/:
  graphml.xsd, graphml-structure.xsd, graphml-attributes.xsd,
  graphml-parseinfo.xsd, xlink.xsd

The only edit is mechanical: every absolute
"http://graphml.graphdrawing.org/xmlns/1.0/" schemaLocation prefix was
removed so the files resolve one another from this directory. Target
namespaces and all type definitions are untouched.
